info.title: SiteCheck API
info.description: Pay-per-call tools for AI agents: image generation, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, embeddings, LLM chat, website audits and contact enrichment, web page to Markdown reader, PDF to text, sitemap URLs, tech stack detection, translation, exchange rates, e-mail pre-check, domain RDAP/DNS lookup, Solana token checks, trending tokens and wallet holdings, plus business and compliance data (EU VAT/VIES, IBAN, LEI/GLEIF, US recalls, OSHA/EPA violations, UK insolvency notices). Plus prediction-market search, briefs, quotes and unsigned buy transactions, powered by Panta. Payment: x402, USDC on Base, Solana or Arc. No signup, no API key.
info.x-guidance: Call any /api/* operation without payment first. The 402 answer's PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 JSON, x402 v2) lists one "exact" USDC option per network (Base, Solana, Arc). Sign one with an x402 client and repeat the request with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Payment settles only when the call succeeds.

get.summary: Validate an EU VAT number with VIES
get.description: EU VAT number check: format and checksum are tested locally first (a malformed number is rejected with HTTP 400 and no charge), then the official VIES service answers whether it is valid, with the registered name and address where the member state discloses them. All 27 EU states plus Northern Ireland (XI). Source: European Commission VIES.

200.description: Successful result (shape shown by the schema and example)

402.description: Payment required (x402). The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header lists one option per network.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: VAT number with its 2-letter country prefix, e.g. DE811907980 (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland). Spaces and dots are ignored

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional: country code, if the number has no prefix

get.summary: Validate IBANs and split bank and account codes
get.description: IBAN validation with no network call: ISO 13616 length and structure for every country in the SWIFT IBAN registry, the mod-97 checksum, national check digits where a public algorithm exists (FR, ES, IT, BE, NL, NO, FI, PL, PT and the Balkan countries), and the split into bank code, branch code and account. Returns the electronic and print format. Pass ibans= for up to 50 at once. No bank name or BIC lookup (no dataset is bundled).

200.description: Successful result (shape shown by the schema and example)

nationalCheck.note: no public national check-digit algorithm is applied for this country

402.description: Payment required (x402). The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header lists one option per network.

parameters.name: iban
parameters.description: One IBAN. Spaces, dashes and lowercase are accepted

get.summary: Search OSHA and EPA enforcement cases by company
get.description: US workplace and environmental enforcement cases by company, state and date: OSHA inspections with penalties (US Department of Labor API) and EPA enforcement cases (EPA ECHO), each with the official record link. Filters: company, state, since, minPenalty, source. OSHA is included only when the deployment has a DOL key; the answer says so otherwise. Public records matched by name, not a finding of guilt.

200.description: Successful result (shape shown by the schema and example)

results.type: Judicial, CAA §111, Final Order With Penalty

notes: OSHA is off on this deployment (DOL_API_KEY is not set): only EPA results are included.
example.caveat: Public enforcement records, matched by name: they show inspections and cases, not guilt or current compliance. Check the record link before relying on a row.

get.summary: Search UK company insolvency notices
get.description: UK company insolvency notices (administrations, liquidations, winding-up petitions and similar) from The Gazette, read from our own nightly cache of the last 8 days. Filter by company name or number, postcode prefix, notice type and since date. Returns company, number, notice type, date, nature of business, liquidation type, postcode, notice link, the cache's dataTimestamp and any missing days; with a Companies House key on the deployment, up to 10 rows also get company status, incorporation date, SIC codes and address.

get.description: Read one web page as clean Markdown (or plain text) for an LLM: the main content without menus, cookie banners and footers, plus title, description, author, published date, language and canonical URL; links on request. robots.txt is respected (a disallowed page is refused and not charged). get.summary: Check e-mail addresses without sending mail
get.description: E-mail pre-check without SMTP: syntax, whether the domain can receive mail (MX or implicit MX, null MX, non-existent domain), disposable domain (9,000+ domain CC0 list), role account (info@, sales@...), free provider and a typo suggestion (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Verdict invalid / risky / unknown. Up to 50 addresses per call with emails=.
